scope_notes: Seed catalog for native Apple Maps rail imagery capture. A metro is included when it has public rapid transit, light rail, streetcar, automated people mover connected to the urban network, or scheduled commuter/regional rail. Amtrak, VIA Rail, bus-only places, airport-only people movers, and heritage/tourist-only operations are excluded.

Bounds are conservative, provisional capture corridors in [south, west, north, east] order. Multiple boxes deliberately follow rail corridors and urban clusters rather than enclosing an entire metropolitan area. Review and refine them against the current agency map before a production-scale capture.

The catalog is a defensible seed rather than a claim of exhaustive North American rail coverage. Systems that are suspended, reduced, or have uncertain current operations are retained only with an explicit note so the capture runner can decide whether to skip them.

cities.name: Atlanta
cities.notes: MARTA heavy rail corridor plus downtown streetcar.

cities.name: Atlantic City
systems: NJ Transit Atlantic City Rail Line
cities.notes: Atlantic City terminal area for the scheduled NJ Transit commuter/regional rail line; Philadelphia is covered separately.

cities.name: Austin
cities.notes: Red Line regional rail; keep both the downtown/airport-adjacent urban area and north corridor.

cities.name: Albuquerque–Santa Fe
cities.notes: Commuter/regional rail corridor. Use separate Albuquerque and Santa Fe boxes rather than a large empty high-desert rectangle.

cities.name: Baltimore
cities.notes: Includes core rail and MARC commuter approaches; corridor extent is intentionally limited.

cities.name: Boston
cities.notes: Boxes cover the Boston rapid-transit core and principal commuter branches to Providence, Lowell, Newburyport and Worcester.

cities.name: Buffalo
cities.notes: Single light-rail/metro corridor from downtown to University station.

cities.name: Charlotte
cities.notes: Blue Line, Gold Line streetcar and core extension corridors.

cities.name: Chicago
cities.notes: Includes CTA core and selected Metra/South Shore commuter reaches, including northwest Indiana; not every outer Metra terminus.

cities.name: Cincinnati
cities.notes: Downtown/Over-the-Rhine streetcar loop.

cities.name: Cleveland
cities.notes: Includes Red, Blue and Green rail. HealthLine is BRT and must not be treated as rail.

cities.name: Dallas–Fort Worth
cities.notes: Core DART plus commuter corridors to Fort Worth, DFW Airport and Denton; includes the locally operated M-Line trolley.

cities.name: Denver
cities.notes: Light-rail and commuter-rail corridors, including airport and Boulder/Longmont-facing northern reach where service operates.

cities.name: Detroit
cities.notes: Both systems were publishing operating schedules on 2026-09-08. Preserve a day-of service check because the People Mover has scheduled maintenance closures and QLINE has previously altered hours.

cities.name: El Paso
cities.notes: Streetcar loop and university/downtown corridor.

cities.name: Honolulu
cities.notes: Operational Skyline segment; retain separate airport/downtown boxes when future extensions open.

cities.name: Houston
cities.notes: Red, Green and Purple Line corridors.

cities.name: Jacksonville
cities.notes: Downtown automated people-mover network; include as public urban rail, with a day-of check for construction or service changes.

cities.name: Kansas City
cities.notes: Main Street streetcar corridor, including the 2025 extension area.

cities.name: Kenosha
cities.notes: Local circulator. It is included because it is a scheduled municipal streetcar, though its heritage fleet warrants a low-priority capture flag.

cities.name: Little Rock–North Little Rock
cities.notes: River Rail streetcar loop.

cities.name: Las Vegas
cities.notes: Scheduled public monorail on the Las Vegas Strip. It serves a tourist-heavy corridor but is retained as local urban rail.

cities.name: Morgantown
cities.notes: Automated PRT serving the university and downtown; public service scope and operating calendar should be checked before capture.

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.notes: Rapid rail core and selected regional commuter approaches; excludes far outer Metrolink termini.

cities.name: Memphis
cities.notes: Current MATA notices and its 2025 Main Street map indicate active trolley service, with detours possible. Preserve a day-of service check because the system has experienced extended suspensions and phased restarts.

cities.name: Miami
cities.notes: Includes the urban elevated network and Tri-Rail’s Miami–Fort Lauderdale corridor.

cities.name: Milwaukee
cities.notes: Downtown streetcar.

cities.name: Minneapolis–Saint Paul
cities.notes: Blue and Green light rail are active. Northstar is listed for corridor coverage but its current/reduced service status must be checked before capture.

cities.name: Nashville
cities.notes: WeGo Star weekday commuter rail from Lebanon to downtown Nashville; retain only urban and near-suburban corridor boxes.

cities.name: New Haven
cities.notes: Local hub and regional corridors; boxes avoid treating the whole New York–Boston intercity route as urban capture.

cities.name: Norfolk–Virginia Beach
cities.notes: Norfolk light-rail corridor.

cities.name: New Orleans
cities.notes: Canal, Riverfront, St. Charles and Rampart streetcar corridors.

cities.name: New York–Newark
cities.notes: Regional grouping includes New Jersey and Long Island commuter corridors but stops short of the most distant NJ Transit/Metro-North branches.

cities.name: Oklahoma City
cities.notes: Downtown streetcar loop.

cities.name: Orlando
cities.notes: Central Florida commuter rail corridor; use smaller boxes around active urban nodes.

cities.name: Philadelphia–Camden
cities.notes: Core network plus Camden and regional rail approaches; exclude Amtrak-only stations.

cities.name: Phoenix–Tempe–Mesa
cities.notes: Light rail and Tempe streetcar corridors.

cities.name: Pittsburgh
cities.notes: T light-rail corridors only; inclines are excluded from this rail-transit scope.

cities.name: Portland
cities.notes: MAX, streetcar and WES commuter rail corridors.

cities.name: Providence
cities.notes: Providence/Stoughton commuter-rail urban corridor, listed separately for capture despite overlap with the Boston regional system.

cities.name: Sacramento
cities.notes: Light-rail trunk and principal branches.

cities.name: Salt Lake City
cities.notes: TRAX/S-Line core and FrontRunner’s urban Wasatch Front reaches.

cities.name: San Diego
cities.notes: Trolley core plus North County regional rail corridors.

cities.name: San Francisco–Oakland
cities.notes: Bay Area regional grouping. Boxes cover the dense BART/Muni/Caltrain core and selected East Bay, Sonoma–Marin and ACE corridors.

cities.name: San José
cities.notes: Separate South Bay capture group despite Caltrain overlap with San Francisco. Amtrak-operated intercity routes are excluded.

cities.name: Seattle
cities.notes: Link, streetcar and Seattle Center Monorail core plus selected Sounder commuter corridor; Tacoma is a separate compact capture group.

cities.name: St. Louis
cities.notes: MetroLink Illinois and Missouri corridors.

cities.name: South Bend–Michiana
cities.notes: South Bend terminal-area capture for the scheduled South Shore regional commuter rail line; the Chicago end is covered by the Chicago group.

cities.name: Tacoma
cities.notes: T Line streetcar and Tacoma Sounder terminal area.

cities.name: Tampa
cities.notes: Downtown–Ybor streetcar corridor.

cities.name: Tucson
cities.notes: Sun Link streetcar corridor.

cities.name: Washington–Arlington
cities.notes: Metrorail core and selected Virginia/Maryland commuter approaches; MARC overlap with Baltimore is intentional.

cities.name: San Juan
cities.notes: Puerto Rico is included under US country coding; Tren Urbano corridor only.

cities.name: Calgary
cities.notes: Red and Blue Line urban corridors.

cities.name: Edmonton
cities.notes: Capital, Metro and Valley Line corridors.

cities.name: Kitchener–Waterloo
cities.notes: ION corridor and urban GO/Kitchener line stations.

cities.name: Montréal
cities.notes: Metro/REM core and selected exo reaches on both shores.

cities.name: Ottawa–Gatineau
cities.notes: Confederation and Trillium line corridors; service configuration can change during staged restoration/extension work.

cities.name: Toronto–Hamilton
cities.notes: TTC core, UP Express and selected GO corridors through the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area; not every outer GO terminus.

cities.name: Vancouver
cities.notes: SkyTrain core, Canada Line and selected West Coast Express reach; do not expand to bus-only Fraser Valley areas.
